title: Omubaka Eyayolekera Abasinza Ebifaananyi
intro: Mu kiseera ng’okwewaayo kubuze, omubaka yasituka n’omulanga okudda mu kusinza Mukama w’ensi. Ekifaananyi kino kyayimirira nga kinywevu ku bantu abaali basimbye emirandira mu kusinza katonda ow’obulimba, nga babajjukiza Omutonzi waabwe ow’amazima era Mukama wa bajjajjaabwe. Naye abantu tebaafaayo era ne bagaana okulabula, ne bassaako akabonero ku nkomerero yaabwe. Ono eyakubira essimu atawuguka yali ani?
clues: Nasindikibwa eri abantu abaali bavudde mu kkubo lya Katonda Omu ow’amazima.
Nabuuza abantu bange nti, "Temujja kutya Allah?"
Nnabayita balekere awo okusinza katonda ow’obulimba ayitibwa Baali.
Abantu bange baagaana omulanga gwange ne banywerera mu kusinza ebifaananyi byabwe.
Olw’okwegaana kwabwe, mazima bajja kuleetebwa okubonerezebwa.
Mukama wange yampa emirembe n’okujjukira okw’omukisa mu milembe egyaddirira.
verse: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers, (37:123)
